posts.description:
Neptune Laundry's residential pickup and delivery service works in four steps. Step one: schedule a pickup through the Neptune app on iOS or Android, or book online. Step two: place your laundry in any bag you have at home, no sorting required. Step three: a Neptune associate picks up the bag from your home in East Boston, MA. Step four: your clothes come back washed with the Ozone System, fully dried, and neatly folded, delivered to your door.

No special equipment, no time spent sorting, and no waiting at the laundromat. You schedule, our team handles everything, and your laundry returns ready to put away.

Have you been putting off trying pickup delivery because you were not sure how it worked? The four steps above are all there is to it. Schedule through the Neptune app today.

First-time customers using Neptune Laundry's residential pickup and delivery service can save $20 on their first order by applying code FIRST20 at checkout. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android, or book online, and enter the code when placing your order.

No sorting required on your end. Bag your clothes in whatever you have at home, schedule the pickup, and our team in East Boston, MA handles the wash, dry, and fold from start to finish. Your clothes are returned to your door clean, fully dried, and neatly folded.

This is the simplest way to experience pickup delivery with a team that has over 25 years of laundry service experience in the Greater Boston area. Schedule your first order and use code FIRST20 to save today.

Carrying bags of laundry down stairs or to a laundromat is physically demanding, and for seniors or residents with limited mobility in East Boston, MA, it creates a real barrier to clean clothes. Neptune Laundry's residential laundry pickup and delivery service removes that barrier entirely.

Our team picks up your laundry from any bag you have ready, no special preparation required, and returns it clean, dried, and neatly folded to your door. No heavy lifting. No trips to the laundromat. No waiting through wash cycles.

This service is available throughout East Boston and the Greater Boston area through the Neptune app on iOS or Android, or by scheduling online. Have you or someone you know been struggling with laundry because getting to the laundromat is physically difficult? Pickup delivery is the practical answer.
